newsitem.title: INDIA: India soldier, 4 militants die in Kashmir gunfight.
newsitem.headline: India soldier, 4 militants die in Kashmir gunfight.

text.p: One Indian soldier and four separatist guerrillas were killed in a 12-hour gunbattle on the outskirts of troubled Kashmir's summer capital, police said on Sunday.
A police spokesman said the shootout began late on Saturday in Ganderbal, some 22 km (14 miles) north-east of Srinagar, summer capital of the state of Jammu and Kashmir.

"Army troops on a specific information on Saturday evening cordoned off village Achhan of Ganderbal area, during which the hiding militants opened fire. The fire was returned and in the ensuing encounter, which lasted for 12 hours, four militants were killed," the spokesman said.
Nine houses caught fire and were gutted in the operation, which was continuing, the spokesman added.
An army soldier was was seriously injured in the encounter, police said.
More than a dozen miltant groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Jammu and Kashmir state, mainly India's only Moslem majority province.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in a seven-year-old rebellion in the Himalayan state.
